title: Tell HN: The site was offline. What changed?
guide_zh: HN 离线维护后更新存储路径，作者解释迁移结果与启动速度改善。
author: kogir
excerpt: Obviously things took longer than intended and expected, but in the end: Items moved from /12345 to /12/34/12345. HN now starts in one fifth the time, and better utilizes the filesystem cache. Backup speeds are also improved. Profiles moved from /kogir to /ko/gi/kogir, and from /KogIr to /%k/og/%kog%ir, which works on case-insensitive filesystems. Similar performance improvements were observed. Passwords moved from a 45MB user->hash mapping file into user profiles themselves.
